summary: A morning newspaper you would know from one crop, with a real desk behind it: a ladder that climbs to edition 153, a mastery that sets tomorrow's ten from what keeps catching her, and three doors opened by playing rather than paying.
fixes: The win filmstrip never reaches the win: frames 5-20 of moment-win.png are identical on the answered sheet, because the page goes to press at at(12.0) (TodayView.swift:261) after the strip's 20 fast frames have run out - move it to at(9.5) and drop qa.json's moment delay to 7.5

Largest text breaks the head of the question sheet: GENERAL KNOWLE/DGE splits mid-word and Q4 OF 10 - E... truncates (ax-02-question.png) - cap the sectionMark row at accessibility1 with minimumScaleFactor and whole-word wrapping (QuestionSheet.swift:135-155)

The printer's fist renders as an emoji in blue, pink and teal on the paywall and the composing room (RootView.swift:30 -> PaywallView.swift:96) - draw it as a SwiftUI Shape or force text presentation so it takes the section ink
The ladder's first rung is at edition 39, so ladder.png's first two panels are interchangeable - step the hard dial every 26 instead of 38, which still leaves flattensAt at 131 (Desk.swift:28-29)

Settings is white capsule cards on newsprint under a sans-serif large title, the one screen where the newspaper stops (08-settings.png) - give the rows the ruled-box treatment and name the screen in the paper's words
Onboarding page one opens on ~380px of dead paper above the masthead and draws the press smaller than mock-3 promised - set artHeight 340 and HandPress(width: 330) (AppInfo.swift:22)
The paywall subhead duplicates bullet one (RootView.swift:32 vs AppInfo.swift:55) and the promise is led by hand.raised.fill, the only SF Symbol on a page of drawn art (PaywallView.swift:144)
